findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Spectrum/Basic.lean:79 defines `resolvent`; roadmap lines 43–45 and 60–62 explicitly require a bounded-case bridge, while `rg -n "resolvent A|resolventSet.*A" code/TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups/BoundedGenerator` finds no such declaration.
findings.fix: Add a public theorem equating this resolvent with `resolvent A lambda` under `‖A‖ < lambda`, deriving resolvent-set membership and using the two inverse identities.
findings.issue: `ofBounded_resolvent_eq_inv_smul_tsum_pow` does not identify the semigroup resolvent with Mathlib’s Banach-algebra `resolvent A lambda`, so consumers cannot use the existing spectrum/resolvent API without reconstructing inverse uniqueness.

summary: The bounded-generator resolvent API stops at the raw Neumann series and omits the roadmap-required bridge to Mathlib’s resolvent.
